compact_evidence.scope: Byte comparison of copied report files against archive members, plus the archive receipt against the raw receipt. New report prose and independent reviews are not archived inputs.

diagnostic_collection.meaning: Archive preservation passed independently of diagnostic completeness. The missing CPU19 row is absent evidence, not a zero; the affected seek session still has measured returned-JIT PASS.

inventory.metadata_scope: Exact paths/type/permission bits/uid/gid/regular-file size/symlink target and mtime at tarfile float precision. Inode/device/ctime/link counts and directory disk sizes remain inventory-only.
inventory.mtime_precision_note: Python stat.st_mtime and tarfile preserve a binary floating-point projection of the nanosecond timestamp. The retained inventory preserves exact mtime_ns; tar members do not preserve all nanosecond digits.
inventory.mtime_projection: (mtime_ns // 1000000000) + (mtime_ns % 1000000000) * 1e-9; exact equality with archived tarfile float mtime, no tolerance

limitations: Inventory equality proves preservation relative to the retained inventory, not capture of files absent from the original inventory.
Source and binary hashes establish retained byte identity, not an independent rebuild.
No archived scripts, generated code or benchmark programs were executed. Kernel image/build identity is retained receipt evidence; the host audit cannot re-observe the prior guest boot.
Present empty kernel logs contain no retained messages. Full inventory preservation cannot prove runtime log-collector completeness; the one known missing CPU19 diagnostic row remains explicit.
Cold-admission explanation uses final whole-session counters with zero completed checks, not invented measured-phase rates. Returned-body evidence is separate from publication.
All 144 measurement sessions are accepted and drained, while the independent diagnostic collection intentionally remains INCOMPLETE with exit code 1.
Rates and statistical comparisons are audited separately; no paired 256-byte baseline or new runtime validation is inferred.
scope: Independent read-only offline archive, inventory, source, binary, image and session-log preservation audit. No VM commands, archived code, builds, tests or benchmark execution.
